implementation.replacementStatus: partial; animation playback and DOM rendering pending
implementation.targetScope: Independent numeric keyframe mapping, MotionValue state/subscriptions/velocity and externally supplied animation lifecycle, plus eight-phase frame and microtask scheduling. Not a drop-in replacement for motion-dom yet.
implementation.remainingWork: Numeric keyframe generators and animation playback; Color/complex-value mixers and grid/random stagger; DOM/WAAPI effects, gestures/layout and full unchanged Framer Motion caller acceptance. The remaining runtime is unimplemented, not retained upstream code.

independentComponents.numeric interpolation: Snapshot ranges, binary lookup, custom mixers and per-segment easing
independentComponents.MotionValue: State, velocity, mutation-safe subscriptions, passive effects and owned external-animation lifecycle
independentComponents.frame scheduling: Eight ordered phases, dedupe/cancellation/keep-alive, microtasks and manual frame processing

changes: No upstream runtime copied; depends only on vmotion-utils.
Owns range and easing-array snapshots; rejects malformed ranges before animation starts.
Binary segment lookup bounds the cost of long numeric timelines.
Cancellation suppresses callbacks already queued in the active phase. Callback failures release processing state and allow remaining work and future frames to proceed.

Synchronous animation completion reports start before completion; late completion after cancellation does not emit a success event. Failed start hooks and throwing stop handlers release owned resources.
MotionValue retains vmotion-utils subscription lifetime protections and stops unobserved animations on the next frame, allowing same-frame resubscription.

caller.scope: Fade/transform animation and Motion value subscriptions beneath motion/react. Built foundation only; application adoption not claimed.
